req.title: Reject invalid date-of-birth format
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when dateOfBirth cannot be parsed as ISO-8601 date.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-024 requires HTTP 422 when dateOfBirth cannot be parsed as ISO-8601 date. Analysis of the source reveals that PlayerRequestModel.date_of_birth is typed as Optional[str] with no Pydantic validator enforcing ISO-8601 format — meaning the field accepts any string. The requirement states the system SHALL reject invalid formats with 422, but the model as written will accept arbitrary strings. Tests must probe: (1) a valid ISO-8601 date succeeds (positive/EP), (2) a clearly malformed string is rejected with 422 (negative/EP), (3) boundary strings that are almost-valid ISO-8601 (e.g. wrong separator, missing day) are rejected (boundary/BVA), (4) a non-date string like 'not-a-date' is rejected (negative/NEG), and (5) a date-time string vs pure date boundary (BVA). Since the model uses Optional[str] without a validator, these tests will expose the gap between the requirement and the implementation — which is exactly what mutation testing needs to surface. Tests assert exact status codes (422 vs 201) to catch operator-flip mutations.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 99 is not present in the database
actions: POST /players/ with dateOfBirth set to a valid ISO-8601 date string '1990-06-15'
expected: Response body contains the created player with the submitted dateOfBirth
trace: R-PLAYER-024: valid ISO-8601 date must be accepted (positive equivalence class)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] == "1990-06-15"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99

test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_returns_201()
